execute.description: Insert one RunSignupRole per legacy BOOSTER role
execute.sql:
INSERT INTO "run_signup_role" ("id", "signupId", "role", "createdAt")
SELECT gen_random_uuid()::text, s."id", s."role", now()
FROM "run_signup" s
WHERE s."participationType" = 'BOOSTER'
  AND s."role" IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM "run_signup_role" r
    WHERE r."signupId" = s."id" AND r."role" = s."role"
  )

postcheck.description: Every BOOSTER with a legacy role has a RunSignupRole row
postcheck.sql:
SELECT NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM "run_signup" s
  WHERE s."participationType" = 'BOOSTER'
    AND s."role" IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM "run_signup_role" r
      WHERE r."signupId" = s."id" AND r."role" = s."role"
    )
) AS ok

execute.description: Copy legacy BOOSTER role onto selected roster entries
execute.sql:
UPDATE "run_roster_entry" AS e
SET "selectedRole" = s."role",
    "updatedAt" = now()
FROM "run_signup" AS s
WHERE e."signupId" = s."id"
  AND e."selected" = true
  AND s."participationType" = 'BOOSTER'
  AND s."role" IS NOT NULL
  AND e."selectedRole" IS NULL

) AS ok
